p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] != 2 and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1] and row[c] != row[c - 1]:
                # Turn the single gap between identical colored cells into 2.
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
''')
